A '''''Rho''-class transport shuttle'''<ref name="Rho DB" /> was in service to the [[Republic Medic Corps]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]<ref name="The Unknown" /> in [[19 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> During the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda]], the [[shuttle]] was employed to transport the [[clone trooper]] [[Tup]] to [[Kamino]] after he had suffered a mysterious medical episode which had led him to [[Death|kill]] [[Jedi General]] [[Tiplar]] in the middle of battle. However, the shuttle was ambushed by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army|forces]] before it could jump into [[hyperspace]], and the [[battle droid]]s killed the crew and kidnapped Tup. [[Jedi]] [[General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]] and [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] [[Fives]] subsequently inspected the wreckage and realized what had happened, leading them on a mission to rescue their comrade.<ref name="The Unknown" />
